questions.question_text: Which of these activities helps the most in improving concentration and mental focus?
Why is it important to warm up before playing high-energy traditional games? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Warming up prepares our muscles for physical activity, increases blood flow, and helps prevent serious injuries or cramps while running during the game.

questions.question_text: Describe the correct body position for performing the resting pose, Shavasana. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Lie completely flat on your back with arms relaxed by your sides. Close your eyes, breathe gently, and let your entire body relax.

questions.question_text: Name two local traditional games and state one physical benefit of playing them. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Kho-Kho and Kabaddi are two traditional games. Playing them heavily improves our running speed, agility, and teaches us how to work properly as a team.

questions.question_text: What is the correct way to sit while performing Padmasana (Lotus Pose)? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Sit on the floor, cross your legs, and place each foot on the opposite thigh. Keep your back straight and rest your hands on your knees.

questions.question_text: How does practicing deep breathing (Pranayama) help our mind before a sports match? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Deep breathing helps calm the mind, reduces stress, and improves focus. It brings more oxygen to our brain, making us feel fresh, energetic, and ready.

questions.question_text: Imagine you are the captain of a Kabaddi team. Describe how you would guide your teammates to defend against a very strong raider. [40-50 words]
questions.answer: I would tell my team to hold hands and form a strong semi-circle chain. We must watch the raider's footwork closely, stay calm, and move together. When the raider comes too deep, we will tackle them safely at the waist to avoid injuries.

questions.question_text: Imagine you are doing yoga in a quiet park. Describe the exact steps you take to perform Vrikshasana (Tree Pose) safely and with good balance. [40-50 words]
questions.answer: I would stand tall and slowly lift my right foot, placing its sole gently on my left inner thigh. Once balanced, I would bring my hands together in front of my chest, focus my eyes on one spot, and breathe calmly to hold the pose.

questions.question_text: Explain the importance of honesty and fair play when participating in local traditional games with your friends or classmates. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: Honesty and fair play are essential because they build trust and make the game enjoyable for everyone involved. If someone cheats, it causes arguments and ruins the fun. Following rules strictly, accepting defeat gracefully, and respecting the referee's decisions shows true sportsmanship and strong team spirit.

questions.question_text: Describe a short daily yoga routine for a Class 4 student that helps improve both flexibility and concentration before going to school. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: A good morning routine starts with five minutes of deep Pranayama breathing to wake up the mind. Next, the student should do basic neck and shoulder rotations. After that, they can perform Tadasana to stretch their spine and Vrikshasana to improve balance and focus, ending with a moment of silent relaxation.
